programs.title: Brazil Untamed
programs.desc: In the heart of Brazil, the largest cat in the Americas, the magnificent jaguar, reigns over a magical land filled with natural beauty and diversity.

programs.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue
programs.desc: Tag along as Dr. Amanda rescues a blind pet baboon, and watch Dr. Charlotte’s tricky surgery on a pangolin whose leg must be amputated after a run-in with poachers. Later, chase a rhino, two young baboons gone AWOL, and a fiesty monitor lizard.

programs.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue
programs.desc: Face a tough decision when Esti’s leg infection puts the brakes on this young duiker’s release. Then track and collar a young lion with Dr. Amanda; check on an ailing bush baby; and greet the noisy new addition to the center, a grumpy grey parrot.

programs.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
programs.desc: Freeze time as water becomes a force of change in Earth’s most frigid ecosystems. Hunt for unsuspecting seals with polar bears, bathe in natural hot springs with macaques, and try out a unique survival strategy with Arctic foxes.

director: Andrew Zikking: Executive Producer, Laura Coates: Series Producer

programs.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West
programs.desc: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

director: Nick Robinson: Director, Mark Coles Smith: Narrator

programs.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West
programs.desc: Battle for dominion over the river with crocs, then catch glimpses of an ultra-rare mangrove snake and an endangered nabarlek wallaby. Take to the ocean to see humpback whale mothers raise their calves, then be hunted by false killer whales.

director: Nick Robinson: Director, Mark Coles Smith: Narrator

programs.title: Battle of the Alphas
programs.desc: Australia is home to an eclectic array of creatures, and the ways to succeed as an alpha are just as diverse. The beach turns into a dueling ground, and the outback becomes a boxing ring, as animals face off with their own kind.

director: Karen McCairley: Series Producer, Elliot Halpern and Elizabeth Trojian: Producers

programs.title: Rooted
programs.desc: This is the incredible story of a tree that has been around for eight hundred years… that can withstand the harshest conditions… and that is more loved by insects, birds and animals than any other…the enormous Baobab. Rooted on the savannah of Malilangwe Game Reserve in southern Zimbabwe.

programs.title: Land of Gremlins
programs.desc: This is the story of a day in the life of an Indris Family following a mother, father, and their three offspring around their home in the rainforest of Mantadia National Park in Madagascar.

programs.title: Into the Wild India
programs.desc: Hoolock Gibbons are specialists of the Jungle. Living in close knit families, youngsters spend years learning the skills to survive. Meet Samar as he forages for food, avoids predators, and masters the acrobatics required for a life in the trees.

director: Ben Roy, Allison Bean, Valeria Fabbri-Kennedy:Producers

programs.title: Into the Wild India
programs.desc: The grasslands of Northeast India are one of the most fertile habitats on earth. Hundreds of species of tall grass flourish here, allowing one of India’s most iconic creatures to thrive… the Greater One-horned Rhino.

director: Ben Roy, Allison Bean, Valeria Fabbri-Kennedy:Producers

programs.title: Into the Wild India
programs.desc: The Ladakh plateau is a land of extremes, but the Tibetan wild ass is the king of this grassland. Follow one stallion as he shadows a herd of females for his chance to sire the next generation, but in doing so, he must battle those wanting his crown.

director: Ben Roy, Allison Bean, Valeria Fabbri-Kennedy:Producers
